test_title: PYST 20: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 24 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

Loud fireworks also have an _______ on glaciers.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"effect" **is a noun, which is the correct part of speech needed to complete the sentence.
 
• The word **"affect"** is a verb and would not be appropriate in this context.
 
• **"Effecting" **and "affect" do not fit grammatically in the given sentence structure.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Loud fireworks also have an** effect **on glaciers."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Effect:** As a noun, it means a change which is a result or consequence of an action or other cause.
 
• **Affect:** As a verb, it means to have an effect on; make a difference to.
 
• **Effecting:** As a verb, it means to cause something to happen; bring about.
 
• **Affect:** Incorrect form as it does not fit in the context of the sentence.
